subject: intr
title: (R)INTR.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 454 (MP(I)-28). INTR (interpretation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), LANG-DY (language dynamics) and MOT-DY. From T-C-IMP: CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis). From LANG-DY: IST-F (isolated focus). From MOT-DY: TR (transformation). From CULT-AF-BS: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From TR: C-INFO (composite information).
